triage.headline: CONSTRUCTIVE TOTAL LOSS REVIEW
triage.summary_reason: Estimated visible repair cost (AED 12,070.00) represents 80.5% of the pre-accident vehicle value (AED 15,000.00), crossing the 50% economic threshold specified under UAE Unified Motor Policy (50%). Formal total-loss salvage review is recommended.
triage.recommended_action: Initiate salvage valuation and total-loss settlement workflow.
